final.investment_thesis:
The bear’s tape case is the stronger near-term evidence. The same 10-Q was repriced by the market with a -7.35% move on 132.5M shares, and seven sessions later AAPL still sits below the 10 EMA at 315.25 and below the 50 SMA at 309.70 after a failed reclaim. The sequence of lower highs at 316.29, 314.81, and 308.26, bounce volume decaying from 75.0M to 34.4M shares, VWMA at 319.09 as trapped supply, MACD at 0.072 against a 3.26 signal, and RSI at 44.10 without an oversold bid all argue the bear flag resolves lower. That supports reducing exposure now rather than waiting for a break of the triple-tested 300.00–302.56 floor. The aggressive analyst is right that a 15.06% weight is an active bet in a broken tape, and the conservative analyst is right that 316.29 is a narrative invalidation rather than an executable protective stop.

But this is not a Sell/exit. The franchise is not broken: nine-month revenue is +16.1%, Q3 gross margin is 50.06%, EPS is +22.4%, nine-month FCF is +52.5% with 1.15x cash conversion, net cash is $62.17B, debt is down $14.31B, and the 200 SMA at 279.64 is still rising with price 10.24% above it and the 50-over-200 spread positive at 30.06. The balance sheet and still-intact primary uptrend cap the case for full liquidation. The unresolved margin-durability question—memory-cost inflation, an unconfirmed iPhone price increase, a tax rate reset, and slower buybacks—supports trimming, not abandoning the name.

Sizing is the real dispute. The aggressive 0.08 and the research plan’s 0.08 are defensible in direction but slightly too large for a 2.90% ATR setup with a binary margin narrative and incomplete disclosure. The conservative 0.05 over-discounts the quality case and treats a gap through 300 as more than a tail. The neutral 0.065 is the best expression: about $6,480 of the $99,687.57 book, or roughly 21 shares, selling about 27.7 shares at the next open. That keeps meaningful participation in the iPhone 18 cycle and any confirmed re-rating while cutting the position by more than half. Conditional narrative plans: re-add toward 0.10 only on a close above 316.29 with volume above 60M that also reclaims the 10 EMA at 315.25 and VWMA at 319.09; cut toward 0.03 on a decisive close below 300.00, with next supports at 299.53, 289.20–294.38, and the 200 SMA at 279.64; do nothing between 304.61 and 316.29. No mechanical stop inside the 299.50–304.61 zone because it sits within one ATR and is a stop-hunt magnet.

What would change the call: a volume-confirmed reclaim of 316.29/319.09 and the 10 EMA would justify moving back toward 0.10; a Q4 print holding gross margin near or above 48.5% with intact revenue guidance and credible memory-cost offsets would argue for restoring more exposure; a decisive close below 300.00 would justify cutting toward 0.03. Stated gaps not papered over: no product-line or geographic revenue split, no 10-K note resolving the $13B intangible / $13.5B noncurrent liability, no Apple confirmation of the iPhone pricing story, no sentiment report, and only 20 of 165 eligible news records in the supplied snapshot.
final.time_horizon: 1-3 months, re-underwritten at the next quarterly print
